attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Utah state income tax. Flat 4.5% rate (Utah Code § 59-10-104, 2025; reduced from 4.55% by HB 106) on AGI minus per-dependent personal exemption ($2,111). Utah's Taxpayer Tax Credit (6% × deductions+exemptions, phased out at 1.3% above thresholds) is omitted in this implementation — a follow-up will add it. Writes result.ut_taxable_income, result.ut_tax, result.ut_state_tax.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.ut_tax = 0; set result.ut_state_tax = 0; set result.ut_taxable_income = 0; set result.ut_base_tax = 0; set result.ut_taxpayer_credit = 0; set result.ut_military_retirement_credit = 0.0; perform UT_Military_Retirement_Credit; set result.ut_taxable_income = the maximum of result.state_calc_agi and 0.0; set result.ut_base_tax = result.ut_taxable_income * ut_tax_rate; add " Utah Tax Calculation (Form TC-40, 2025) - 4.5% less the taxpayer tax credit and the military retirement credit" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.ut_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.ut_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.ut_taxable_income xdef 0 cvd /result.ut_base_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.ut_taxpayer_credit xdef 0.0 cvd /result.ut_military_retirement_credit xdef /UT_Military_Retirement_Credit performtable result.state_calc_agi 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ut_taxable_income xdef result.ut_taxable_income ut_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.ut_base_tax xdef " Utah Tax Calculation (Form TC-40, 2025) - 4.5% less the taxpayer tax credit and the military retirement credit" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Married filing jointly or surviving spouse: $36,426 phase-out base
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

action_details.action_comment: TC-40 lines 11-20: 6% of (dependent exemptions + federal deduction) less 1.3% of taxable income over $36,426
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ut_taxpayer_credit = the maximum of ((length of job.dependents * ut_personal_exemption + result.total_deduction) * ut_taxpayer_credit_rate - (the maximum of (result.ut_taxable_income - ut_credit_phaseout_joint) and 0.0) * ut_credit_phaseout_rate) and 0.0
action_details.action_postfix: job.dependents length ut_personal_exemption fmul result.total_deduction f+ ut_taxpayer_credit_rate fmul result.ut_taxable_income ut_credit_phaseout_joint f- 0.0 fmax ut_credit_phaseout_rate fmul f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ut_taxpayer_credit xdef

action_details.action_comment: TC-40 lines 11-20, head of household base $27,320
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ut_taxpayer_credit = the maximum of ((length of job.dependents * ut_personal_exemption + result.total_deduction) * ut_taxpayer_credit_rate - (the maximum of (result.ut_taxable_income - ut_credit_phaseout_hoh) and 0.0) * ut_credit_phaseout_rate) and 0.0
action_details.action_postfix: job.dependents length ut_personal_exemption fmul result.total_deduction f+ ut_taxpayer_credit_rate fmul result.ut_taxable_income ut_credit_phaseout_hoh f- 0.0 fmax ut_credit_phaseout_rate fmul f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ut_taxpayer_credit xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ut_taxpayer_credit = the maximum of ((length of job.dependents * ut_personal_exemption + result.total_deduction) * ut_taxpayer_credit_rate - (the maximum of (result.ut_taxable_income - ut_credit_phaseout_single) and 0.0) * ut_credit_phaseout_rate) and 0.0
action_details.action_postfix: job.dependents length ut_personal_exemption fmul result.total_deduction f+ ut_taxpayer_credit_rate fmul result.ut_taxable_income ut_credit_phaseout_single f- 0.0 fmax ut_credit_phaseout_rate fmul f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ut_taxpayer_credit xdef

action_details.action_comment: TC-40 line 22 tax less the taxpayer tax credit, line 24 less the military retirement credit (code AJ), not below zero
action_details.action_dsl: set result.ut_tax = the maximum of (result.ut_base_tax - result.ut_taxpayer_credit - result.ut_military_retirement_credit) and 0.0; set result.ut_state_tax = result.ut_tax; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = result.ut_taxable_income; set result.computed_state_tax = result.ut_tax; add " UT tax 4.5% of $" + result.ut_taxable_income + " = $" + result.ut_base_tax + "; taxpayer tax credit $" + result.ut_taxpayer_credit + "; military retirement credit $" + result.ut_military_retirement_credit + "; tax $" + result.ut_tax to job.audit_trail
action_details.action_postfix: result.ut_base_tax result.ut_taxpayer_credit f- result.ut_military_retirement_credit f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.ut_tax xdef result.ut_tax cvd /result.ut_state_tax xdef result.ut_taxable_income cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.ut_tax cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef " UT tax 4.5% of $" result.ut_taxable_income strconcat " = $" strconcat result.ut_base_tax strconcat "; taxpayer tax credit $" strconcat result.ut_taxpayer_credit strconcat "; military retirement credit $" strconcat result.ut_military_retirement_credit strconcat "; tax $" strconcat result.ut_tax strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

policy_statement.policy_description: Utah MFJ/QSS (2025 TC-40): 4.5% of Utah taxable income (federal AGI; the standard deduction and exemptions are not subtracted), less the taxpayer tax credit (6% of the federal deduction plus $2,111 per dependent, phased out at 1.3% of taxable income over $36,426) and the military retirement credit (4.5% of military retirement pay, code AJ).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Utah MFJ/QSS (2025 TC-40): 4.5% of Utah taxable income (federal AGI; the standard deduction and exemptions are not subtracted), less the taxpayer tax credit (6% of the federal deduction plus $2,111 per dependent, phased out at 1.3% of taxable income over $36,426) and the military retirement credit (4.5% of military retirement pay, code AJ)."

policy_statement.policy_description: Utah HOH: as above with the $27,320 phase-out base.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Utah HOH: as above with the $27,320 phase-out base."

policy_statement.policy_description: Utah Single/MFS (2025 TC-40 lines 9-25): 4.5% of taxable income, less the taxpayer tax credit (6% of the federal deduction plus dependent exemptions, less 1.3% of taxable income over $18,213; Utah Code 59-10-1018) and the military retirement credit (Utah Code 59-10-1043).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Utah Single/MFS (2025 TC-40 lines 9-25): 4.5% of taxable income, less the taxpayer tax credit (6% of the federal deduction plus dependent exemptions, less 1.3% of taxable income over $18,213; Utah Code 59-10-1018) and the military retirement credit (Utah Code 59-10-1043)."

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Utah military retirement exclusion. Skeleton — see issue #446. UT allows up to $10,000 exemption on military retirement pay with income caps ($50k Single / $65k MFJ AGI); must choose between military retirement or Social Security exemption.

condition_details.condition_comment: The taxpayer has military retirement pay included in AGI

Full-year resident entry only. A part-year or nonresident entry's income is built from the income entities, so the pension is not in it, and 4 U.S.C. 114 bars a state from taxing a nonresident's retirement income (#1330 review).

action_details.action_comment: TC-40A Part 3 code AJ worksheet: taxable military retirement pay times 0.045 (Utah Code 59-10-1043)
action_details.action_postfix: taxpayer.military_retirement_pay ut_tax_rate fmul cvd result.ut_military_retirement_credit f+ /result.ut_military_retirement_credit xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: Military retirement credit, TC-40A Part 3 code AJ: 4.5% of military retirement pay included in AGI, nonrefundable, no carryforward, not with the retirement credit code 18 (Utah Code 59-10-1043; 2025 TC-40 instructions p. 21-22). Utah has no exemption for the pay itself.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Military retirement credit, TC-40A Part 3 code AJ: 4.5% of military retirement pay included in AGI, nonrefundable, no carryforward, not with the retirement credit code 18 (Utah Code 59-10-1043; 2025 TC-40 instructions p. 21-22). Utah has no exemption for the pay itself."

policy_statement.policy_description: No military retirement pay for this taxpayer.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "No military retirement pay for this taxpayer."

policy_statement.policy_description: Not a full-year resident entry: the pension is not in this entry's sourced income (the roster builds it from the income entities) and 4 U.S.C. 114 bars taxing a nonresident's retirement income, so nothing is subtracted.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Not a full-year resident entry: the pension is not in this entry's sourced income (the roster builds it from the income entities) and 4 U.S.C. 114 bars taxing a nonresident's retirement income, so nothing is subtracted."
